## What this package is

`agentomicsCore` provides the infrastructure for LLM-orchestrated,
fully-audited bioinformatics pipelines. It is omic-agnostic: domain
packages (scAgentKit for scRNA-seq, atacAgentKit for ATAC-seq, etc.)
sit on top of it and contribute the domain-specific tools.

The four big pieces:

1. **`AgentOmics`** — an S4 container that wraps a data payload plus
   a decision log and reproducible R script.
2. **`record_step()` / `find_in_decisions()`** — the extension API.
3. **Multi-provider chat_fn factory** with token tracking.
4. **`render_report()`** with an `extras` hook for domain extras.

## Architecture sketch

```
+--------------------------+
|  AgentOmics              |
|                          |
|  @data       (ANY)       |
|  @data_type  (chr tag)   |
|  @stage      (chr)       |
|  @decisions  (list)      |
|  @scripts    (chr vec)   |
|  @figures    (df)        |
|  @params     (list)      |
|  @token_usage(list)      |
|  @version    (chr)       |
+----------+---------------+
           |
           v
    record_step()
           |
+----------v---------------+      +-------------------+
| obj@decisions appended   |      | chat_fn factory   |
| obj@scripts appended     |      | chat_claude(), .. |
| obj@params merged        |      | chat_deepseek(),..|
| obj@stage optionally upd |      +---------+---------+
+--------------------------+                |
                                            v
                                +----------------------+
                                |  per-call token      |
                                |  records into        |
                                |  agentomicsCore::    |
                                |    token_state       |
                                +----------+-----------+
                                           |
                                           v
                                attach_step_tokens(obj, step, t0)
                                           |
                                obj@token_usage[[step]] populated
```

## Hello world

```{r}
library(agentomicsCore)

# Wrap any BioC-ish payload
obj <- AgentOmics(my_data, data_type = "seurat",
                  initial_script = '# loaded my data')

# Issue an LLM call
chat <- chat_claude()
resp <- chat(system = "You are a careful bioinformatician.",
             user   = "Suggest 3 QC checks.")

# See the per-call token usage
token_usage_summary()$total
```

## Writing a downstream package

A minimal downstream function:

```{r}
my_qc <- function(obj, threshold = 1000, ..., rationale = NULL) {
  stopifnot(methods::is(obj, "AgentOmics"))

  # Snapshot tokens at entry so per-step attribution works
  t0 <- length(agentomicsCore::token_state$records)

  # ... your work, possibly involving chat_fn calls ...

  obj <- agentomicsCore::record_step(
    obj            = obj,
    step_name      = "my_qc",
    function_name  = "my_qc",
    params         = list(threshold = threshold),
    rationale      = rationale %||% "default",
    script_snippet = sprintf("obj <- my_qc(obj, threshold = %s)", threshold),
    new_stage      = "qc_done"
  )

  agentomicsCore::attach_step_tokens(obj, "my_qc", t0)
}
```

## Reporting with domain extras

```{r}
render_report(
  obj,
  path  = "report.html",
  extras = list(
    my_section = function(o) {
      stuff <- o@params$my_section_data
      if (is.null(stuff)) return("")
      sprintf("<section><h2>My domain section</h2><p>%s</p></section>",
              esc_html(stuff$summary))
    }
  )
)
```
